Standard text uses the same font families and weights as Figma: IBM Plex Mono Regular (400), IBM Plex Mono Medium (500), and Orbitron SemiBold (600).
The three static TTFs can be used directly for text. The Source directory retains the official Orbitron variable font.
Fonts come from official Google Fonts distribution channels and include complete OFL licenses. Figma does not export its server-side font binaries, so these match font families and weights; identical server-side font versions cannot be confirmed.
The special Rubik Wet Paint title was rendered directly from Figma as a PNG.
Text_Inventory.csv contains original text and basic styles. All_Texts_And_Styles.json retains styled text segments, colors, letter spacing, line height, position, alignment, and visibility.
Button text with purpose=button_label_baked_into_png is already composited into the button PNG. Do not overlay it again.
